'''Heljus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], Heljus was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and taking the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Elsor]] as her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during a [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|campaign]] to keep the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] from taking the planet, Heljus and her student were posted in the [[Clabburn Tundra]] near to [[Aurek Base]].<ref name="TOR" />

During a mission into the tundra, the Jedi pair and their troops were ambushed by a mysterious force. Heljus used the Force to cause an avalanche, allowing Elsor to escape and return to the base to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]]; Master Heljus did not return however. Disoriented form the avalanche and with all communications blocked by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], Heljus was able to discover the source of the disturbance in the tundra; the [[Beast-Lord]] named [[Brutann]] from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Mortally wounded during a confrontation, Heljus was able to transmit a warning to her apprentice before succumbing to her wounds. This information allowed for a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to track down and kill the beast lord and end his attacks against the Republic.<ref name="TOR" />
